Os espaços de vida de Pokémon, <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Não acha?

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,94)><$facial(1,2)>Just as in the other towns, I imagine there may be some

<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,2)>Afinal, temos muitos gostos e preferências diferentes.

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)>I’ll leave the method and details to you. I know you’ll do
